title: Courses kept offline
summary: A switch on a course that downloads all of its audio and pictures and keeps them downloaded as it grows.
description: For a learner about to be without a connection. Audio and pictures are otherwise made the first time a lesson needs them, which takes the network and the learner's key.

stories.as: a learner about to board a flight
stories.soThat: I can practise it with no connection

stories.as: a learner who keeps a course offline
stories.want: to see what is downloaded and what will still need a connection

stories.as: a learner downloading a course before a trip
stories.want: to see how far the download has come, and have it go on with the app closed
stories.soThat: I can put the phone away while it downloads

requirements.text: A course can be marked to be kept offline with a switch on its page; no course is marked until the learner does so.
Switching it on starts downloading everything the course lacks that is not a conversation: audio, example sentences and pictures.

history.text: Switching it on starts downloading everything the course lacks: the audio of everything its lessons say and every picture they show.
history.reason: The owner decided a course kept offline has everything that is not a conversation, so example sentences and slow versions are downloaded too.

requirements.text: The audio counted for a course is everything its lessons say, each at normal speed and slowly: words, sentences, dialogue lines, a story's sentences in each speaker's voice, a scene's sentences, its words' example sentences, each word's near neighbour by sound, and the built-in sound pairs that have one of its words or a word of its sentences.

history.text: The audio counted for a course is every word, sentence and dialogue line of its lessons, a story's sentences in each speaker's voice, a scene's sentences, each word's near neighbour by sound, and the built-in sound pairs for the sounds its words have.
history.reason: The owner decided a course kept offline has everything that is not a conversation, so example sentences and slow versions are downloaded too.

history.text: The audio counted for a course is everything its lessons say, each at normal speed and slowly: words, sentences, dialogue lines, a story's sentences in each speaker's voice, a scene's sentences, its words' example sentences, each word's near neighbour by sound, and the built-in sound pairs for the sounds its words have.
history.reason: Lessons now play only sound pairs with their own words, from words lessons and sentences lessons.

requirements.text: The pictures counted for a course are the words of its picture lessons, each scene, and each panel of its stories.
A course is ready offline when every counted clip, every word's example sentences and every picture are stored; its page shows how many of each are downloaded.

history.text: A course is ready offline when every counted clip and picture is stored; its page shows how many of each are downloaded.
history.reason: The owner decided a course kept offline has everything that is not a conversation, so example sentences and slow versions are downloaded too.

requirements.text: A course that gains content after it was ready is no longer shown as ready until the new audio and pictures are stored.
For courses kept offline, missing example sentences and audio are fetched by itself at startup and after the tutor adds to a course.

history.text: For courses kept offline, missing audio is fetched by itself at startup and after the tutor adds to a course.
history.reason: The owner decided a course kept offline has everything that is not a conversation, so example sentences and slow versions are downloaded too.

requirements.text: Pictures are drawn for a course kept offline only when the learner switches it on or taps Download now, which also retries pictures that failed before. By itself the app leaves a lesson's pictures to the device that made the lesson.
The page says how many of the course's lessons are conversations, which need a connection whatever is downloaded.
Without an OpenRouter key nothing is downloaded, and the page says a key is needed.
Switching it off deletes nothing that was downloaded.
The mark syncs with the course and what was downloaded syncs as files: a course made ready on one device is ready on the others once they have synced.
A course is downloaded once at a time: asking again while a download runs starts no second one.
While a course downloads on Android, the app is kept alive with a notification, so leaving the app or turning the screen off does not stop the download.

history.text: While a course downloads on Android, the app is kept alive with a quiet notification.
history.reason: The owner wants to follow a download's progress and have it go on when the app is not open.

requirements.text: Every word of a course kept offline has its example sentences written ahead and stored.
Without a chosen chat model no example sentences are written, and the page says a model is needed.

The notification names the course and shows how many of its items are downloaded out of how many; when the download ends it says the course is ready offline, or how many items could not be downloaded.
If Android stops the app before a download ends, the course's example sentences and audio go on downloading without the app being opened, once there is a connection.
